_doc: I2C pin selection patterns and SoC data. A pin is I2C only when the workbook's SELECTED function says so (I2C_QUPn, I2C_QUPn_SEk ...); the 'interfaces' capability list is never used. A QUP I2C uses the same `qupN` pinctrl function as SPI and UART, so the pin tables are READ FROM spi_profiles.json (Linux pinctrl driver of the SoC) and not copied. 'controller_defined' lists the I2C controller numbers the SoC's mainline dtsi really defines; any other number gets a controller label that is marked as a guess. CCI (camera control interface) and non-QUP I2C are listed as left out, never guessed.
